reasoning.why_this_shape: Hand-authored baseline for the Sequencer, targeting the story_graph.json default_path: CP1:SABOOT -> CP2:CHAARA -> CP3:TRACK_B -> CP4b:SACH_KI_DAAK -> E4_WAHI_RAAT. This is the 'fate + justice' canonical playthrough — she dies, he wins, the invariants hold. Alternative track_a segments (ep4a + cp4a) are included so the Director-v2 can experiment with re-routing per cohort. Every checkpoint uses the new visible checkpoint_menu model per story/README.md; my sim still treats them via the interaction_agent kind (persona picks an outcome; the visibility difference doesn't change simulation semantics).
